data.name: Exploding Trap
data.description: You can only add this to a fire trap. The trap explodes in fire, filling all squares adjacent to the trap and dealing 1d6+%1 points of fire damage (Reflex negates). If it is an extraordinary trap, the ranger must use an explosive material such as alchemist's fire when setting the trap.|ExplodingTrapBonusDamage
